text:
Ana Torres: Heads-up team 00: scheduling the Migration Studio week for two enterprise customers + a few SMBs. Need to finalize 60m workshop + two 30m drop-ins.
Rob Kim: Suggest we do deep-dive in EMEA-friendly window and one AM slot for APAC folks. keep drop-ins in the middle of the week.
Sophie Li: I can lead schema mapping and pre-migration checks. available Tue/Thu mornings UTC.
Evan Brooks: I'll cover Dedicated sizing and cost walk-through. prefer Wed 14:00-17:00 UTC.
Ana Torres: Proposed grid (pick 1 for deep-dive + confirm 2 drop-in possibilities):
- X: Mon 17:00 UTC (60m deep-dive)
- Y: Wed 15:00 UTC (60m deep-dive)
- Z1: Tue 08:00 UTC (30m office hour)
- Z2: Thu 12:00 UTC (30m office hour)
Ana Torres: React :x: for X, :y: for Y (use :two: if you prefer Z1/Z2 ordering) and drop notes if conflicts.
Rob Kim: :two: (Y) fits infra team overlap.
Sophie Li: :two: for Y, I can prep pre-read and an example mapping file.
Evan Brooks: :two: as well. will prepare a short cost calc and p95 latency targets.
Ana Torres: Pre-read checklist: 48h prior, include current token rates, request sample prompt set, include terraform example for dedicated pool.
Ana Torres: terraform snippet for pre-read:
```terraform
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "example" {
  gpus = 2
  region = "eu-central-1"
  max_concurrency = 80
}
```
Sophie Li: I'll add a small sample mapping (CSV) and an automated validation script.
Evan Brooks: I'll add a sizing slide and quick formula: expected_qps = tokens_per_min / avg_tokens_per_request.
CS Ops Bot: Calendar event created: Migration Studio Deep-dive (Y) Wed 15:00 UTC. Invitees: enterprise contacts, internal leads. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1757001234
Ana Torres: Thanks bot. Please also create two 30m drop-ins (Z1, Z2) and set capacity to 12 each. RSVP link please.
CS Ops Bot: Drop-in events created: Tue 08:00 UTC and Thu 12:00 UTC. Capacity 12. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/studio/dropins/1757001234
Rob Kim: I'll message the two enterprise contacts for pre-read signoff and ask for their scale numbers.
Sophie Li: Who will own post-session feedback? we usually run a 4-question pulse.
Ana Torres: Can you own the feedback form Sophie? tag follow-ups into Gainsight if priority high.
Sophie Li: Yep will do. will share the form link in this thread after creation.
Evan Brooks: Quick ask: can we include a short benchmarking table for typical model sizes (7B/13B/70B) in the pre-read? I can draft.
Ana Torres: Yes please. reconvene Friday 15m dry-run. I'll send the invite.
Rob Kim: :thumbsup:
Sophie Li: :white_check_mark:
Evan Brooks: all good from infra side.
Ana Torres: Great, locking Y as primary. Closing thread but will post final calendar links once created.
